answers.reason: As a member of the central university leadership, the vice president for studies takes part in the central body that decides university-wide strategy and structure.
Budget planning is the domain of the chancellor, and members do not sit in bodies dealing with other kinds of questions.
The vice president for studies is responsible for teaching and degree programmes, not faculty appointments.
The faculty council handles the affairs of a single faculty, whereas the vice president operates at the central university level and does not sit in bodies for other matters.
The study commission prepares changes to degree programmes and deals directly with teaching, which is the specific area of responsibility of the vice president for studies.
Although the vice president is responsible for examinations across the university, the examination board deals with individual student cases at the faculty level rather than university-wide matters.
Research funding is unrelated to the vice president's remit of teaching and degree programmes.
Rewriting module descriptions for a single programme is a local working task, and higher officers do not sit in bodies outside their specific central place.
The description explicitly states that laboratory equipment decisions have no bearing on study programmes, and members do not sit in bodies for other kinds of questions.
Planning the orientation week for new students is outside the vice president's formal responsibility for degree programmes, examinations, and teaching quality.
